blocks.text: East Central homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

East Central, September 2026. Detached houses: 82 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 120 listed at month end and 11 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 36 over 4 months against an average of 75.8 listed, about 8.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 17 sold. condos and townhomes sold 68 over 4 months against an average of 113.2 listed, about 6.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 22 sold.
